name: AI Docs Review Command

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr:
        description: 'Pull Request number'
        required: true
        type: string
      repo:
        description: 'Repository name (optional)'
        required: false
        type: string
      gitref:
        description: 'Git reference (optional)'
        required: false
        type: string

jobs:
  ai-docs-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4.2.2
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.gitref }}
          repository: ${{ inputs.repo }}

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Validate PR number
        id: validate_pr
        run: |
          if ! [[ "${{ inputs.pr }}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::PR number must be a valid integer"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Post error comment if validation fails
        if: ${{ failure() }}
        run: |
          gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/issues/${{ github.event.issue.number }}/comments \
            -X POST \
            -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" \
            -H "Authorization: token ${{ github.token }}" \
            -d '{"body": "Invalid PR number provided. Please provide a valid integer."}'

      - name: Fetch changed files
        id: fetch_files
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER=${{ inputs.pr }}
          REPO_NAME=${{ github.repository }}
          CHANGED_FILES=$(gh api --paginate "/repos/$REPO_NAME/pulls/$PR_NUMBER/files" -q '.[].filename' | tr '\n' ' ')
          echo "CHANGED_FILES=$CHANGED_FILES" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Post start comment
        run: |
          gh api issues/${{ github.event.issue.number }}/comments \
            -X POST \
            -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" \
            -H "Authorization: token ${{ github.token }}" \
            -d '{"body": "AI docs review started for PR #${{ inputs.pr }}"}'

      - name: Run Devin Action
        uses: aaronsteers/devin-action@0d74d6d9ff1b16ada5966dc31af53a9d155759f4
        with:
          devin-token: ${{ secrets.DEVIN_TOKEN }}
          devin-config: |
            {
              "reviewers": ["@ian-at-airbyte"],
              "files": "${{ env.CHANGED_FILES }}"
            }
